title: Jab Madine ka
body:
jab madine ka musafir koi paa jaata hoo
hasrat aati hai ye pahuncha mai raha jaata hoo
do qadam bhi nahi chalne ki hai mujh may taaqat
shauq khaynche liye jaata hai mai kya jaata hoo
<<DIVIDER>>
khaafile waale chale jaate hai aage aage
madad ae shauq ke peeche mai raha jaata hoo
jab madine ka musafir...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaarwan may rahe yasrab may hoo aghaaz zera
sab may shaamil hoo magar sab se juda jaata hoo
jab madine ka musafir...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab madine ka musafir koi paa jaata hoo
hasrat aati hai ye pahuncha mai raha jaata hoo
jab madine ka musafir...
<<DIVIDER>>
faiz e maula se abhi sabr ki taqat hai ameer
jo kadi saamne aati hai utha jaata hoo
jab madine ka musafir...

hasrat aati hai ye pahuncha mai raha jaata hoo
jab madine ka musafir...
author: Ameer Hussain Mashadi
